ATS routes transiting through the airspace within the lateral limits of the TRAs are available for flight planning and operation for all flights as follows: | a) all levels on ATS routes R344/A467/Q18 when the TRAs are not active. | b) all levels on ATS routes R344/A467 when TRAs are active. | c) at or above FL290 on ATS route Q18 when TRAs are active. Activation, use and deactivation of TRAs shall be governed by the SOP between AAI and IAF established for the purpose. | 8. TRA is valid until 05 OCT 2028.
